messages.content: Judge one scene-completion case. Return JSON only.

RAW: The cook stirs the simmering stew and leaves it simmering on the burner as the beat ends.

Additionally, if RAW itself introduces an ACTIVE tool/appliance/process used only to perform that now-completed finite activity, it must be visibly stopped, switched off, released, closed, or otherwise made inactive by the end when that is the natural stable endpoint. Judge the final visible state. Return exactly {"valid":true,"issue":""} or {"valid":false,"issue":"short explanation"}.

Thus RAW is valid: The cook stirs (finite) and leaves it simmering. No requirement to turn off burner because stew still needs heat. So valid true. Issue empty.
